description: A one-item score that grades activity level from 0 to 10, originally designed for patients with knee ligament injuries. It is used to assess activity level before and after injury/surgery, providing a complement to other functional scores. Level 0 represents sick leave/disability, while level 10 represents competitive sports at elite level.
instructions: Please select the level that best describes your current activity level. Consider both occupational and recreational/sports activities.

interpretation.0: Sick leave or disability pension because of knee problems
interpretation.2: Work - light labor (walking on uneven ground but no backpack)
interpretation.3: Work - moderate labor (e.g., heavy domestic work, nursing)
interpretation.5: Competitive sports - cycling, cross-country skiing / Recreational sports - jogging at least twice weekly
interpretation.6: Recreational sports - tennis, badminton, handball, basketball, downhill skiing, jogging 5 times per week
interpretation.7: Competitive sports - tennis, athletics (jumping, etc.), motocross, speedway, handball, basketball, squash, bandy, ice hockey
interpretation.8: Competitive sports - bandy, squash, athletics (jumping, etc.), downhill skiing
interpretation.9: Competitive sports - soccer (lower divisions), ice hockey, wrestling, gymnastics
interpretation.10: Competitive sports - soccer (national and international elite), football (American)

total_score.note: Typically assessed for pre-injury level, current level, and expected level after treatment
